In what system is a person interested? In most modern nations' tax, transportation systems such the traffic management. In this answer an illustration on public highway toll roads and their traffic flow will show its workings.
  
In some states (especially larger, highly-poplated and congestional) public roads require fees paid as you travel a highway stretch via Electronic toll system (or other types).

Taxis on those highway sections can either pass the highway toll station by collecting money, using credit card machines. Alternatively (if available on a road section in question and if not yet in credit) by the means that can scan the toll collector license tag. (Electronic Toll Systems). 
When traveling such road with the help and use on an Electronic Transceiver installed and in proper use at vehicle the road segment fees is deducted as one drive on, without requiring stopping or waiting in the dedicated collection areas
